summary: Icons-on-presets feature verified end-to-end on BOTH backend and frontend. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_presets_icons.py — 10/10 passed. Frontend: full Playwright flow on 390x844 with demo@hibinomi.app covering every acceptance criterion in the request (default icons on pills, icon picker on sheet, chip-selected label, icon change persists on Home, reopen+highlight confirms persistence, add new size 750 ml with jar icon via focused input (deselects chip → 'Icon for new size'), tap quick-add-750 logs 750 ml, remove via preset-remove-<ml>, reset+save restores defaults WITH default icons, Settings preview shows icons + button opens sheet). Cleanup done: 750 ml intake deleted, demo user presets reset to defaults [{100,glass},{200,glass},{250,glass},{300,mug},{500,bottle}]. Full regression (pytest -o addopts= -v) on backend passed 25/25; running under xdist gives 3 flakes in Reports/CSV classes (pre-existing cross-worker fixture issue in backend_test.py — user_a fixture is module-scoped but xdist LoadScope splits classes across workers, so Reports/CSV asserts has_data=True on a worker that never saw TestIntakes). This flake predates the icons feature. No React Native red screen; no new deprecated packages introduced for this feature. Verification SVG-level: icon changes were asserted by comparing phosphor-react-native path `d` attribute signatures of each pill before/after, confirming the actual rendered icon changed (not just state).

minor.issue: backend_test.py's module-scoped user_a fixture is not safe under pytest-xdist LoadScope — TestIntakes seeds intakes on worker A but TestReports/TestExport run on worker B against a fresh user, so has_data=False and CSV has 0 rows. Fix: either scope user_a to 'session' + explicitly seed intakes in Report/Export class setup, or set --dist loadfile. Pre-existing; not caused by icons feature. Serial run (addopts stripped) passes 25/25.

action_items: (Optional, test-harness only) Make backend_test.py xdist-safe: either scope user_a to 'session' and ensure TestIntakes runs before Reports/CSV on the same worker, or configure --dist loadfile so all classes in that file share one worker. Does not block the icons feature.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py normalize_presets() correctly handles legacy integer presets AND new {amount_ml, icon} dicts, falling back to default_preset_icon() when icon missing — good forward/backward compatibility.
PresetIn validates icon against the 6-key allowlist with 422 on unknown (verified: 'rocket' -> 422). amount_ml 1..5000 bound still enforced.

PresetsSheet 'activeIcon' derivation correctly switches between selected-chip icon and new-size newIcon (with defaultIcon fallback based on the typed amount) — matches spec: 'focusing deselects chip, label Icon for new size'.
iconFor() in presets.ts falls back to Drop for unknown keys — safe render even if backend ever returns a bad key.

testID coverage is complete and matches the review request exactly: preset-icon-picker, preset-icon-{glass,mug,bottle,drop,wine,jar}, preset-chip-<ml>, preset-remove-<ml>, preset-amount-input, preset-add-button, presets-save-button, presets-reset-button, quick-add-<ml>, settings-presets-preview, settings-edit-presets.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 preset-icon tests + 25/25 regression serial; 32/35 under xdist due to pre-existing fixture race, unrelated)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 request bullets verified: default icons, picker row, icon change + persistence + highlight, add-with-jar + tap-logs-750, remove, reset-with-default-icons, Settings preview+edit)

seed_data_creation: Created and immediately deleted one 750 ml intake on demo@hibinomi.app during the icon-tap verification. Demo user presets restored to defaults [{100,glass},{200,glass},{250,glass},{300,mug},{500,bottle}]. Several TEST_<uuid>@hibinomi.app accounts created by the two pytest files (pre-existing pattern, same as iteration 1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Icons feature is stable. Preset shape in GET/PUT /api/profile is [{amount_ml:int, icon:'glass|mug|bottle|drop|wine|jar'}]. default_preset_icon mapping on backend: ml<300 -> glass, 300<=ml<500 -> mug, ml>=500 -> bottle (identical mapping on frontend via defaultIcon in src/lib/presets.ts). To assert icon rendering in Playwright, compare SVG inner <path d=...> signatures of the quick-add pills (phosphor-react-native renders unique paths per icon); using class names or role is unreliable. Watch out: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is NOT xdist-safe (see action_items); run with `pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/` to get a clean 35/35 serial pass if needed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works. Flaky backend_test.py xdist failures RCA: pytest-xdist LoadScope splits classes to workers; module-scoped user_a is instantiated per worker, so a worker that only runs TestReports/TestExport has a user with no intakes and thus has_data=False / 0 CSV rows. Mitigation: switch distribution to loadfile, or seed intakes within the TestReports class.
